McLaren is running a special livery at the British Grand Prix, inspired by the fictional Yamura team car from the 1966 film 'Grand Prix', which featured Bruce McLaren's actual car.

It celebrates the deep roots of F1 history and the pioneering spirit of Bruce McLaren, connecting new fans to the sport's origins.

No plane error detected. The narrative is consistent across historical and commercial dimensions.
